last_scene.summary: Arlequino continued the early set with playful high-energy material. 'Лев спит' became a contagious call-and-response around the repeated chant; tips +9s36c. 'Хакуна Матата' was performed as multiple roles by Arlequino alone, loudly and theatrically, with foreign wording translated/adapted in-world; the crowd joined the refrain and laughed at the comic dialogue; tips +11s64c. He then performed the user-supplied parody 'Если б я был Князем', whose recurring joke structure contrasted the appeal of three wives with escalating inconveniences. The strongest crowd reactions landed on the concrete punchlines about three mothers-in-law, drunkenly coming home to three separate quarrels, and the final conclusion that if he were a ruler he would remain unmarried. The archer reacted especially to the lyric explicitly assigning her the task of mending boots. Reactions were varied rather than uniformly admiring. Tips for 'Если б я был Князем' +13s08c; expenses 0.
last_scene.continue_from: T+129 ~18:49 at the small combat yard. Roughly eleven minutes remain before the official 19:00 concert start. Arlequino is on the wooden box with violin; crowd is lively and still gathering. Personal cash 20g45s08c.

critical_rules: User alone controls Arlequino dialogue, feelings, decisions and meaningful actions.
Preserve user-supplied Arlequino wording verbatim when it matters.
World and NPCs are autonomous; Arlequino is not the center of all events.
NPC knowledge must come from realistic in-world sources; no knowledge leakage; UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN.
NPC reactions follow personality/role and may be positive, negative, distracted, mocking or indifferent.
For known songs, use real listener comments/reactions as the primary reaction model. Preserve those reactions closely and only adapt explicitly otherworldly/modern references to fit Tensura.
Do not reduce song reactions to lyric sentiment; rhythm, energy, delivery and crowd dynamics can dominate.
When user supplies lyrics, tie reactions to actual supplied lines and do not invent lyric content.
Include personal cash in every RP response.
After every actual public performance report income, expense, net and new personal cash.
Personal cash is separate from promo/project funds.
Jura is a region; no Jura Tempest Federation yet.
